li.p: Open the driver’s door using the emergency key.
For more details, refer to “Locking/unlocking with the mechanical key” on page 0-00.
Press the 12V BATT RESET button to reconnect the battery.
After pressing the 12V BATT RESET button, start the vehicle within 15 seconds.
With the vehicle started (READY indicator ON), keep the vehicle stopped or drive for approximately 30 minutes to fully recharge the battery.

If the vehicle is not started immediately after pressing the 12V BATT RESET button, the battery power will be automatically disconnected after a few seconds to prevent further discharge. If the battery disconnects before starting the vehicle, press the button again and start the vehicle immediately.

Repeated use of the 12V BATT RESET button without keeping the vehicle in the READY state for at least 30 minutes may cause over-discharge of the battery, which could prevent the vehicle from starting.
If the battery becomes too discharged for the reset function to operate, jump-start the vehicle. For more details, refer to .
